Hello, my name is Kochi, a V-type who is active in distribution.
I find Ran-sensei's illustrations very cute!
Please be sure to have your teacher draw my illustration!

[Character image.
I am a mine girl with blue hair and blue eyes, and my mascot is a cream-colored Pomeranian.
She has an active personality and loves to laugh.

Requests]
Please use a horizontal composition. We would like the dog to appear on the screen. I would be happy if the composition is cute and a little sexy. The rest of the details are up to you!

Usage.
Use as a thumbnail on YouTube
Posting on SNS such as Twitter
We would like to make and sell a small quantity of goods.

Thank you for checking to the end!
We look forward to your consideration!

   Use
◯ Use on social networking sites, homepages, and distribution sites such as YouTube (there is a possibility of monetization in the future).
Posting on FANBOX or distributing as personal wallpaper
Commercial use (merchandise, etc.)
When we use your illustration, we may use it in combination with text, frames, or other materials, or trim it.

Character Outline
The character is a cow girl of the half-animal tribe (demon tribe) with a motif of milk.
She has cow ears and a silver tag on her left ear.
She has asymmetrical horns on her left and right sides.
She has two-tone long hair with loose waves and half-twins, which is hard to see in the standing picture.
She has a calm and gentle personality.

Requested details
We would like to use her as a key visual and would like you to draw a full-body portrait of her.
Pose: She is a calm, gentle, and innocent character, so we would appreciate it if you could draw her in a cute pose that is not too energetic, but still gives a sense of movement.
◯Costume: We would like you to draw her in the "normal costume" shown in the link. (There is a three-sided drawing.)

We would appreciate it if you could draw the head and ears so that we can use them as thumbnails.
We would appreciate it if you could provide us with psd data with the characters, background, signatures, etc. layered.


If there are any discrepancies in the content or amount, please resend the data to us.
Thank you very much for your time and consideration.
